project.name: Hyprland Desktop Shell
project.description: Shared coordination state for Claude Code and Codex.

events.summary: Cloud setup: session-start hook, codex-bridge MCP config, Codex plugin, and a CLAUDE.md rule to delegate visual work to Astra.
events.notes: Hook tested from clean build (exit 0, ~3s); bridge launches via .mcp.json paths and reports Codex logged in; agent-sync tests 17 passed. Codex login must be redone per new container.

events.summary: Design brief recorded; ARCHITECTURE.md maps ownership and the contracts the visual layer must keep; harness can render prototype shells via SHELL_PATH.
events.notes: Astra: read ARCHITECTURE.md (contracts 1-21, Systems requests, Seeing your work). Shader effects render nothing in the headless harness. Ask Claude for systems changes via publish --type note/blocked.

events.summary: UI-001 phases 1–4: explored Parallax, Cut and Interleaf and selected Interleaf, a readable index of work with an inverse navigation margin, opaque celadon fields, numbered workspace passages and a precise red selection rule. It fits all four fixture window titles and five workspace slots at 1080p, retains real service/key flows, and needs no shader, blur or ambient animation. RECON, CONCEPTS, DIRECTION, runnable prototypes, 22 judged PNGs and validation are delivered; production is untouched. Four phase commits are preserved in build/UI-001-astra.bundle because shared Git metadata is read-only; the actual assigned branch remains at 9fe38cd pending import.
events.notes:
S01 ESSENTIAL: Production background-layer host on Ui.screen, behind windows, no focus/exclusive zone, safe output lifecycle and static idle behavior.
S02 ESSENTIAL FOR FULL MOTION: Bounded Deck enter/exit/cross-bay visual retention with immediate telemetry/audio demand release, focus handling and rapid-switch cancellation; instant off/lowEffects.
S03 ESSENTIAL: Stable keyed notice/popup identity and arrival-based expiry; deterministic notices above Deck; sharing indicator always visible; avoid duplicate shell.notify success annotation.
S04 ESSENTIAL: Installer-managed Hyprland animation rules for shell namespaces, preserving user rules/dialects; prevent compositor motion stacking and motion-off violations; no blur requested.
S05 ESSENTIAL FOR COMPLETE CONTROLS: Capability-aware brightness/network services and non-focusing real-value volume/brightness OSD; unavailable/permission/failure states, no visual polling.
S06 ESSENTIAL FOR LOCK SURFACE: Secure WlSessionLock/PAM lifecycle with retry, output and suspend/resume handling; retain external locker until ready.
S07 OPTIONAL: Capability-aware Bluetooth and display-configuration services, demand-driven with real acknowledged actions.
S08 OPTIONAL PREREQUISITE: Reference-count Audio.detailed before any second detailed-volume consumer; current design has only one.
S09 OPTIONAL: Implement actual notification action invocation and capability reporting before exposing action buttons.
S10 OPTIONAL: Installer-supported static compositor focus-border palette mapping, preserving user overrides; no QML tracking border or app-animation change.
No new public config keys, palette renames, font packages, shaders, blur rules, classifiers or telemetry feeds requested. Exact surface/why/done criteria in docs/design/DIRECTION.md.
Validation: Node 100/100, Qt V4 100/100, Python 68 passed/1 skipped; baseline and selected full scenarios passed; 720p compact/Noto/off/lowEffects and uiScale 2 checks passed; privacy-over-Deck PNG inspected; all final QML logs free of binding/type/reference errors. Stable idle: 0.12% core, 1.7 switches/s, 107.2 MiB versus baseline 0.13%, 2.2/s, 85.0 MiB. Real Hyprland/GPU/hardware/lock not verified.
Git handoff: actual branch could not be committed because /home/user/aerolith/.git/worktrees/aerolith-astra is read-only. Verified portable bundle holds 7c58a40, ef30f58, 816f3a0, b71f9ea on codex/astra-visual-language; see build/UI-001-import.txt. No push or branch switch. One review of Claude handoff recorded in RECON.md.
